L3 section for this exact symptom orders the code surface first, and it is not clean: checkoutservice main.go PlaceOrder contains an injected loop 'for i := 0; i < 10; i++ { f, _ := os.Open("/src/log.csv"); r := csv.NewReader(f); r.ReadAll(); f.Close() }' that re-opens and fully re-parses a CSV file 10 times on every order request, i.e. work the request does not need. money/money.go is stock upstream code and clean, so the mechanism is a code class rather than a resource class. Object layer confirms a pure performance fault, not a crash: all 11 boutique pods are 2/2 Running with RESTARTS=0 and checkoutservice-6fc6d649d8-ztlsj is Running. Config face: GetAppYAML shows resources limits cpu=200m / memory=128Mi with requests 100m/64Mi, grpc probes on the correct port 5050, all downstream env addresses set and the checkoutservice ServiceAccount present - so the wasted CPU is turned into hard CFS throttling by the 200m limit. GetErrorLogs(checkoutservice) returns no error logs (the defect wastes work without erroring) while GetRecentLogs shows elongated [PlaceOrder] entries and istio-proxy 'error probes grpc request not finished within timeout: DeadlineExceeded'; the namespace event surface shows only pod-level 'Readiness/Liveness probe failed: context deadline exceeded' on the current checkoutservice pod (probe timeouts caused by throttled response, not probe misconfiguration) plus historical FailedCreate/serviceaccount-not-found noise from repeated rollouts that all recovered. Root cause: excessive file reads injected into checkoutservice's PlaceOrder handler; victim app: checkoutservice.
